activity_summary: When you came in, Mistress Ansell had kept back a slice of her own Twelfth-cake and stood over you while you ate it. You did not turn the stair into a scene for the comedy. You said you were not ill.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Kept the slice and stood over him. Not given a speech.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: Remembered as the king of the other cake. Not in the house.

facets.activity: Ate Mistress Ansell's slice at the stair

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: She had kept a slice of her own Twelfth-cake, and she stood over me while I ate it.
